top_signals.title: Putin Is Ready to Meet Witkoff, Kushner Again, Lavrov Says
top_signals.summary: President Vladimir Putin is ready to meet US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner in Russia to discuss Ukraine, though it matters what proposals they bring, Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
